title: Instance uniforms cannot be set when shader is inherited from parent and scene is run using change_scene_to_file_path()
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in Godot v4.6.3.stable ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon Vega 10 Graphics (RADV RAVEN) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700U with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (8 threads) - 13.53 GiB memory ### Issue description A node which has inherit_parent_material set to true in the editor cannot read/set an instance uniform if this node was is part of a scene that was run using change_scene_to_file. Running the scene directly works as intended, and allows the node to set instance uniforms. Setting inherit_parent_material to true while the node is already loaded allows the node to set instance uniforms 2d_scene.gd ```gdscript extends Node2D @onready var icon: Sprite2D = $Icon @onready var timer: Timer = $Timer # Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time. func _ready() -> void: timer.timeout.connect(on_timeout) timer.start() func on_timeout()->void: icon.set_instance_shader_parameter("color", Color(randf(), randf(), randf(), randf())) ``` shader.gd ```gdscript shader_type canvas_item; instance uniform vec4 color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5); void fragment() { COLOR = COLOR * color; } ``` button.gd ```gdscript extends Button func _ready() -> void: pressed.connect(on_button_press) func on_button_press(): get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://2d_scene.tscn") ``` 2d_scene when ran directly: 2d_scene when ran from change_scene_to_file: ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open MRP in Godot Editor 2. Run 2d_scene.tscn 3. Note 2d_scene's intended behaviour, where icon.set_instance_parameter in 2d_scene.gd changes Icon's color every 0.5 seconds 4. Run main_menu.tscn 5. Click button labelled Switch Scene, which will load 2d_scene.tscn 6. Note how the icon is unaffected by icon.set_instance_parameter in 2d_scene.gd ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [inherit_parent_material_bug_test_2026-06-06_09-20-03.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28668713/inherit_parent_material_bug_test_2026-06-06_09-20-03.zip)
